name: Vocal Profile (Capture)
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Captures your vocal-tract LPC envelope across your sung range and stores it in a shared profile that voice-instrument can resynthesise with a MIDI keyboard. Sing up and down a chromatic scale on a single vowel - the plugin tracks which MIDI notes have been captured + how many samples each has. Pair with midi-keyboard + voice-instrument to play your voice as an instrument.
